effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Your Turn] When you attack with a Digimon, you may suspend this Tamer to trash the top card of your deck. Then, if the attacking Digimon is [Beelzemon], you may digivolve it into a [Beelzemon: Blast Mode] in your trash for a digivolution cost of 3.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
